summary: A big claim may sound convincing until somebody asks for the details that were left out of the headline.
body: A big claim may sound convincing until somebody asks for the details that were left out of the headline. When Mercury opposes Jupiter, information and expansion face each other directly, making it easy to swing between the inspiring big picture and the inconvenient facts that complicate it. You may hear an exciting promise, ambitious plan, or confident opinion that is broadly right and still much less simple than advertised. Force the pitch to answer for its own logistics before you attach your name, time, or money to it. A genuinely solid strategy will easily survive the friction of being fact-checked.
